name: cascade
description: Multi-model orchestration hierarchy - the session orchestrates and signs off, a lead plans and delivers each vertical slice, an implementer writes the code, a mechanic runs commands

interface.shortDescription: Delegate goals through a layered planning and delivery hierarchy.
interface.longDescription: Slices a goal or converged plan into vertical slices, delegates each to a lead that plans and delivers it, routes implementation to an implementer that writes the code, and routes commands to a mechanic that runs them - while the session reviews plans and signs off on results.
defaultPrompt: Orchestrate this goal through the cascade hierarchy.
Break this converged plan into vertical slices and delegate it.
Delegate implementation and command execution for this task.
